local_review.finding_body: FS-test-contract.2.9 permits build.gradle dependency changes only when the dependency is genuinely needed. StaticMetamodelInitializerTest exercises RuntimeCriteriaBuilder and a generated static metamodel but does not use micronaut-data-jdbc, micronaut-jdbc-hikari, H2, or micronaut-test-junit5. All three Native Image finalization lanes passed after those dependencies were removed, confirming they were unnecessary scope.
local_review.finding_title: Test project declares unused backend dependencies
local_review.fix_note: Removed the four unused JDBC, connection-pool, database, and Micronaut Test dependencies from the coordinate's build.gradle to keep the test project scoped to the behavior it exercises. The exact Forge review finalization command then completed successfully with no further publishable changes.
local_review.review_comment: Reviewed the single-coordinate diff, test source, build configuration, index/stats evidence, and local gate records. The test is library-specific, uses a separate package and public API, has no scaffold body, Native Image skip/tolerance, test-side dynamic-access shortcut, compatibility override, or version-pinned behavior. Only reachability-metadata.json is added as metadata. Reported dynamic-access coverage is 1/1 (100%), above the new-library gate; 1 covered call versus 24 reported library-plus-test metadata entries does not trigger the entry-count mismatch check. Local index gates were green, and the Forge-owned finalizer passed all three native test lanes, metadata validation, style checks, generated-test checks, and regenerated statistics without a further publishable-tree change.
